description: Sends a delivered or failed webhook delivery again now, with the same webhook-id so the receiver can tell it is a repeat, and answers how it went. A delivery still being tried answers already-pending. Only owners and admins can replay one.

reason.description: Why, in a sentence: kept in the workspace's activity.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id from whoami; omit when there is one.

name: replay_webhook_delivery
title: Send a webhook again
